insights: Dark mode-first design with sophisticated shadow elevation system using CSS custom properties (--shadow-elevation-low/medium/high) creating depth without borders.
Card-based masonry layout with intelligent responsive grid (@container queries) that adapts from 1-column mobile to 11-column desktop while maintaining visual hierarchy through varied card sizes.

Microinteraction-rich interface: icon-pulse, icon-shine, active-scale-98/99, and hover-supported transforms create tactile feedback without overwhelming motion-sensitive users (motion-reduce fallbacks throughout).
Hybrid carousel navigation using both auto-scroll transforms (translate3d) and manual navigation arrows, with overflow-visible allowing cards to peek beyond viewport edges.
Sophisticated image optimization strategy: WebP format with size-specific variants (128px, 256px, 1024px) served via optim-images CDN, with video posters for lazy-loading performance.
